Lemma
[Anderson's short-loop subgroup bound]

Source: petersen:page-0310 ↗ def:pet-ch7-manifold-class 1. ch7:7.2.4For fixed $n,k,v,D$ there are $L=L(n,k,v,D)$, $N=N(n,k,v,D)$ such that for every $M\in \mathfrak {M}(n,k,v,D)$, any subgroup of $\pi _1(M)$ generated by loops of length $\le L$ has order $\le N$.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch7-anderson-short-loops ↗ lem:pet-ch7-absolute-volume-comparison \sketch For a subgroup generated by loops of length at most $L$, products of at most $r$ generators move $F$ into $B(x,rL+D)$. Disjoint translates and absolute comparison bound the number of such products. Choosing $L$ and $N$ from the resulting bound forces every generated subgroup to have order at most $N$.

□
